messages:
Rae: Heads-up - planning a 3-email post-signup drip for the benchmark webinar. Main wrinkle: route hot leads (engagement_score >= 80) into SDR webhook within 30m. Also test two preheaders. Thoughts?

Marcus: Love it. Proposed split: hot (>=80) -> webhook + Day0 immediate invite; warm (50-79) -> 3-email drip; cold (<50) -> single recap + re-engage tag. Will build the segment exports.

Jo: Preheader tests: A) 'Watch highlights in 10 mins' B) 'Key latency wins inside'. Keep subjects short. For hot leads add human-from line: "Sam from Redwood".

Talia: CRM handshake: CRMBot needs JSON payload {email, score, utm}. Send via POST to /sdr/lead. Add retry + idempotency key. Also include source=webinar_signup.

Rae: Timing: Day0 immediate for hot, Day1 for warm, Day4 follow-up + playbook CTA, Day10 last-chance. APAC shift: move sends earlier by 8-12h where local_count > 200.

Marcus: Counts: hot ~210, warm ~1.8k, cold ~3.9k. I'll queue exports and add suppression for bounced/unsubscribed.

CRMBot: Reminder: Webhook test endpoint ready at https://hooks.redwood.test/webinar. Send sample payload for validation.

Jo: QA notes: ensure List-Unsubscribe header, mobile preview for dark-mode, and check inlining on CSS. Also track opens + demo-requests via utm_content param.

Rae: Action items: Marcus exports + send lists; Jo prepares subject/preheader variants; Talia runs webhook test today; I'll update the launch doc and post final schedule. Thanks team!
